description: The ordered DPLL search recursively simplifies a finite CNF along a supplied atom list, applying current-pivot unit or absent-opposite rules and otherwise trying the true branch before the false branch.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.solve.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] :
  List α →
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.Cnf α →
      Option (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation α)
